ios.desc:
Prompt Library – Zhok is your modern, minimal app for organizing and managing all your AI prompts in one place. Save your best ideas, categorize them, and access them instantly whenever creativity strikes.
A clean interface, powerful organization tools, and effortless usability—your prompts have never felt this organized.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Zhok – A clean, minimal tool for managing AI prompts

quotes.text:
I built Zhok as an internal tool because I couldn’t find a simple, clean way to organize the AI prompts I use daily. Most prompt managers felt cluttered or under-engineered, so I created something minimal and fast.

Zhok now runs on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, making it easy to manage prompts directly on desktop without grabbing your phone.

Would love feedback from the HN community — ideas, critiques, or suggestions for what to build next.
